{"consolidated_memory":"## ml/serving/batcher.py Latency Spike Investigations

Component: ml/serving/batcher.py (ml pipeline side)
Test coverage: tests/ml/test_batcher.py
Repro method: send the mixed-size request trace

### OCCASION 1: April 2, 2026 - Timezone Awareness Issue
- **Trigger**: only affected clients still pinned to v1 SDK
- **Problem**: latency spike in the batcher
- **Signal**: tail far above the median in the serving histogram
- **Root cause**: naive datetime compared against an aware one
- **Fix**: made every boundary timezone aware at the edge
- **PR**: #5437
- **Branch**: fix/latency-spike-1
- **Result**: job finished in 41 minutes instead of 6 hours

### OCCASION 2: July 19, 2026 - Unicode Normalization Issue
- **Trigger**: only affected jobs scheduled across the midnight boundary
- **Problem**: latency spike in the batcher
- **Signal**: tail far above the median in the serving histogram
- **Root cause**: missing Unicode normalisation before hashing
- **Fix**: normalised to NFC ahead of the digest
- **PR**: #6684
- **Branch**: fix/latency-spike-2
- **Result**: flaky test went from 88 failures per hundred runs to zero

Note: Occasion 2 work reused context from Occasion 1 investigation."}
